Questions

How much does a design cost?

Menu card design is ₹499. All other designs start at ₹399+, depending on what you need.

How do I order?

Tap any Order now button. WhatsApp opens with a message that already names the design you picked. Add your details and send.

Will the design use my name and details?

Yes. The designs in the shop are samples. Your design is made with your names, text, logo, colours and photos.

Can you design something that isn't in the shop?

Yes. Describe your idea on WhatsApp: menu cards, invitations, festival posters, business ads, product ads or social media posts.

When do I pay, and how long does it take?

Payment and delivery time are agreed with you on WhatsApp before work begins.
